title: Shogun 2 remaster pulled by Sega after two days ⚔️
subject: shogun2
description:
Should Sega fix it or drop it? 👇

Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition launched on PC on October 13, 2026. After thousands of negative Steam reviews over bugs, performance and visuals, Sega said on October 15 it is working with platform holders to remove it from sale and reinstate the original Total War: Shogun 2. Existing owners keep access.

Sources: SEGA press release (Sept 16, 2026), PC Gamer (Oct 15, 2026), Insider Gaming (Oct 15, 2026), Shacknews (Oct 15, 2026)
Game footage © SEGA / Creative Assembly.

scenes.text: Two days after launch, Sega is pulling Shogun 2's remaster.
Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition hit PC on October 13 with 4K UI scaling and over 50 new playable factions.
Steam reviews sank to Overwhelmingly Negative over old bugs, performance problems and subpar visuals.
On October 15, Sega said it "has fallen short of both your expectations and our own standards."
Sega plans to delist it and restore the original 2011 game. Current owners can keep playing.
